# UMA Technology

> > Well-researched how-to guides and technical tutorials covering Windows troubleshooting, software fixes, and tech support across 69+ pages of content.

UMA Technology is a comprehensive tech resource site specializing in Windows 11 troubleshooting, system error fixes, and how-to guides. The site covers a broad range of topics from operating system maintenance to software issues, with a focus on practical, well-researched solutions for technical problems.

## Key Topics

- Windows 11
- Troubleshooting guides
- System errors
- DISM
- Error codes
- Tech support
- Software fixes
- NTFS
- OneDrive
- Minecraft
- JavaScript errors
- iPhone battery drain
- Outlook
- Technical how-to

## Core Content & Guides

- [UMA Technology - Home](https://umatechnology.org): Homepage featuring well-researched how-to guides on Windows, tech troubleshooting, and analysis.
- [Windows 11 Troubleshooting & Maintenance](https://umatechnology.org/page/2): Windows 11 troubleshooting guides covering DISM, system errors, and maintenance.
- [Windows & Software How-To Guides](https://umatechnology.org/page/3): How-to guides for Windows 11, iPhone battery drain, and JavaScript error fixes.
